newsitem.title: DENMARK: Banks, Novo help Danish shares up.
newsitem.headline: Banks, Novo help Danish shares up.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Friday, boosted by bank shares and biotech group Novo Nordisk. Dealers expected Monday's trade to be dominated by clothing retailer InWear's bourse debut.
"Sentiment in the market has been generally good but I haven't had so much time to follow it because of InWear trades," a dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index gained 0.36 point to 129.04 in overall bourse turnover of 736 million crowns. The KFX December future rose 0.40 point to 128.70 with 130 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Inwear, at an offer price of 220 crowns, was traded on Friday between 239 and 248 crowns with the last deals closed around 246.5 crowns.
An upturn in bond prices gave bank shares a filip, boosting the index in their turn. Den Danske Bank rose eight crowns to 438 crowns and Unibank gained four crowns to 286.

Novo Nordisk rose 17 crowns to 1,050 crowns, but others in the health field fared less well; Colorplast, due to join the new top twenty list on December 23, fell 23 crowns to 655 and Radiometer shed 14.07 to close at 365.93. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969650
